title: The Exchange Kit That Had to Fit in a Bag
title_ja: かばんに入る交流教材
fact_notes: 登場人物、具体的な出来事・観察・記録は架空の教材例。実在の調査結果ではない。参考リンクは制作台帳であり外部の実証資料ではない。

sentences.en: Two schools in different countries planned an online craft lesson.
sentences.ja: 異なる国の二校がオンライン工作授業を計画した。

sentences.en: Their teachers wanted children to make paper animals together.
sentences.ja: 教師たちは子どもたちに一緒に紙の動物を作ってほしかった。

sentences.en: One teacher prepared a list of colorful materials.
sentences.ja: 一方の教師が色とりどりの材料一覧を用意した。

sentences.en: She shared the list with the partner school.
sentences.ja: 交流校にその一覧を共有した。

sentences.en: The partner teacher explained that some items were difficult to find nearby.
sentences.ja: 交流校の教師は近所で入手しにくい品もあると説明した。

sentences.en: Several students also had to carry their materials quite far.
sentences.ja: 何人かの生徒は材料をかなり遠くまで運ばなくてはならなかった。

sentences.en: A large craft kit would be inconvenient for them.
sentences.ja: 大きな工作セットは彼らには不便だった。

sentences.en: Both teachers agreed to reconsider the plan.
sentences.ja: 両教師は計画を再検討することにした。

sentences.en: They chose materials that both groups could obtain easily.
sentences.ja: 両グループが容易に入手できる材料を選んだ。

sentences.en: The new list included ordinary paper, pencils, and small scissors.
sentences.ja: 新しい一覧には普通の紙、鉛筆、小さなはさみがあった。

sentences.en: Each student could carry the materials in a schoolbag.
sentences.ja: 各生徒は通学かばんに材料を入れて運べた。

sentences.en: The teachers sent sample pictures before the lesson.
sentences.ja: 教師たちは授業前に見本の写真を送った。

sentences.en: During the exchange, the children created animals from their own regions.
sentences.ja: 交流中、子どもたちは自分の地域の動物を作った。

sentences.en: They showed the finished crafts and asked each other questions.
sentences.ja: 完成作品を見せ、互いに質問した。

sentences.en: Some children used plain paper instead of colored paper.
sentences.ja: 色紙の代わりに無地の紙を使う子もいた。

sentences.en: Their creations were different but equally welcome.
sentences.ja: 作品は異なっていたが、同じように歓迎された。

sentences.en: Afterward, the teachers discussed what had made the exchange possible.
sentences.ja: その後、教師たちは何が交流を可能にしたか話し合った。

sentences.en: The activity had not required special or expensive supplies.
sentences.ja: 活動に特別な材料や高価な材料は必要なかった。

sentences.en: Both schools had helped design the lesson from the beginning.
sentences.ja: 両校が最初から授業設計に協力していた。

sentences.en: A shared activity had begun with a shared decision.
sentences.ja: 共同活動は共同の決定から始まった。

questions.prompt: What kind of lesson did the schools plan?
What did the teachers want children to make?
What problem did the partner teacher report?
options: Some supplies were difficult to find nearby.
All students had lost their pencils.
questions.explanation_ja: 一部の材料が近所で入手しにくい。

questions.prompt: Why might a large kit be impractical?
options: The schools were building a new room.
Some children had to carry materials a long way.
The teachers wanted no craft materials.
questions.explanation_ja: 遠くまで運ぶ必要があった。

questions.prompt: What did the new list contain?
options: Ordinary paper, pencils, and small scissors.
questions.explanation_ja: 一般的な紙、鉛筆、はさみ。

questions.prompt: What did teachers send before the lesson?
What did children make during the exchange?
options: Only the same animal chosen by a teacher.
A map of a single country.

questions.prompt: Why was the revised lesson practical for both schools?
options: Every child had to buy an identical expensive kit.
The schools jointly chose easy-to-obtain materials.
The exchange did not involve any children.
questions.explanation_ja: 共同設計で入手しやすい材料を選んだ。

options: Shared decisions help make international activities accessible.
questions.explanation_ja: 共同の意思決定が参加しやすさにつながる。
